title: Juicy Grassy Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring lamb, raspberries, and a blend of spices, resulting in a crumbly and grassy flavor profile, made shojin-friendly by using plant-based ingredients and emulsification techniques to enhance the dish's texture and flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides, stirring occasionally.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the raspberries, vegetable broth, and browned lamb cubes to the tagine or Dutch oven.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Use an emulsifier, such as xanthan gum or lecithin, to enhance the texture and flavor of the dish, if desired.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh raspberries and chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
